_about: nzagbiz.co.nz — site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg).

grid-container.rationale: Layout wrapper (grid-container-wrapper) → EDS section; pale-grey / charcoal-grey / novolyte-blue themes and vertical-padding / article-centered modifiers → section-metadata styles.

grid-multicolumn.rationale: 2–4 column grid of child components (icon-badges, images+text, key-features, forms beside copy) → Columns; the child components become the column cell content.

icon-badge.rationale: Icon image + short heading (TRUTH / QUALITY …, 121 instances) — sits inside grid-multicolumn cells → default content (picture + heading) within a Columns cell.

section-header.rationale: Leaf icon + heading + green sub-heading section intro (101 instances) → default content with a section style.

key-features.rationale: Tinted panel with heading + bullet checklist ('Look', 'Smell'…), usually 2–3 side by side → Cards (text-only variant).

tile-listing.rationale: AEM List of linked tiles ('Related products', 'Explore by animal type') with image, title, copy; v3 adds a 'Show all' expander → Cards (author-curated page links; optional show-all variant).

article-tile-listing.rationale: 'Related articles' rail (14 pages) and the full News & Events article grid (12+ tiles) — lists of article pages with image + title → query-index driven article-listing block (related / all variants).

request-quote-badge.rationale: Promotional panel (free bags / gift voucher offer, product images, 'Calculate my payback' CTA) over a landscape background image → Hero (promo variant).

image-text-badge.rationale: Image beside heading + copy + optional link (imageLeft / imageRight) → Columns; v3 carries a small product table in the text cell.

calculator-intro.rationale: 'Calculate your savings' intro + two coloured link tiles to the calculators → Cards (icon tile variant).

video-container.rationale: Row of video teasers (thumbnail, play button, title, copy) each opening a YouTube dialog → Video blocks with placeholder image (in a Columns/Cards layout).

video.rationale: Video component (YouTube, rendered via the parent video-container dialog) → Video.

news-letter-signup.rationale: Email signup strip on 20 pages (email input + reCAPTCHA, posts to the marketing backend) → custom newsletter form block + submission integration.

contactus.rationale: 'Get in touch' enquiry form (email, name, number, message, reCAPTCHA) on 6 campaign/article pages → custom form block + submission integration.

request-a-quote-form.rationale: 32-field quote request (customer details, product selects with quantities, region, reCAPTCHA) → custom form block + backend integration.

website-signup-form.rationale: 23-field farmer sign-up form (contact details, farm type/size selects, reCAPTCHA) → custom form block + CRM integration.

cmr-calculator.rationale: Whole milk vs Ancalf CMR savings calculator: numeric inputs, product toggle and live computed costs/savings tables (agbizCalculator). Bespoke calculation logic — custom block.

mixing-calculator.rationale: Calf milk-replacer mixing calculator: feeding frequency, weight/age radios, calf count → computed volume, powder kg/bags and water (agbizCalculator). Bespoke calculation logic — custom block.
